{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Filter to only loyal customers
loyal_df = df[df['customer_segment'] == 'loyal']

# Check if any 'converted = 1' appears in 'refunded' orders
refunded_converted = loyal_df[(loyal_df['status'] == 'refunded') & (loyal_df['converted'] == 1)]

# Print the count of such cases
print("Number of refunded orders with converted = 1:", len(refunded_converted))

# If any such cases exist, they indicate a problem with the 'converted' column
if len(refunded_converted) > 0:
    print("Warning: There are refunded orders marked as converted. This suggests 'converted' may not correctly reflect checkout completion.")
else:
    print("All converted orders are completed. No discrepancies found.")"}
